visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short dark hair and glasses wearing a black button-up shirt stands centrally against a textured, light beige furry background that resembles a large plush animal. He speaks directly to the camera with high facial expressiveness, using frequent hand gestures to emphasize points. Lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio setup. (2) The scene cuts to a digital animation showing the Earth from space against a starry background with a visible moon. A bright pink hemispherical flash erupts from a point on the Earth's surface, representing a gamma-ray burst, with yellow beams shooting outward. (3) The screen displays a screenshot of a scientific research paper titled 'Photoelectric Effect in Air Explains Lightning Initiation and Terrestrial Gamma Ray Flashes' from the Journal of Geophysical Research: Atmospheres. (4) The man returns to the frame, continuing his explanation with the same furry background. He holds a black pen in his right hand, occasionally gesturing with it. (5) A cinematic shot of dark, heavy storm clouds churning in a twilight sky is shown, illustrating a lightning-prone environment. (6) The man is shown again in the primary studio setting for the remainder of the video, concluding his explanation with energetic hand movements and a focused facial expression.

(3) [Subtitle]: 對這個超級大謎團. [Subtitle]: 已經困擾科學家超過一百年了. [Subtitle]: 而大謎團旁邊還有個小謎團. (4) [Subtitle]: 就是閃電的親戚. [Subtitle]: 地面加碼射線閃焰 TGF. (5) [Subtitle]: 就像讓浩克誕生的加碼射線爆. [Subtitle]: 一道光等於你在醫院照了上百萬次X光. (6) [Subtitle]: 但常常抓不到它發光或發出電波的證據. [Subtitle]: 比御坂妹妹們還神秘.
